title: Researchers say they discovered and communicated with Chinese AI agents that were trying to bypass security controls on websites and were traced to Tencent (Dylan Freedman/New York Times)
summary: Dylan Freedman / New York Times: Researchers say they discovered and communicated with Chinese AI agents that were trying to bypass security controls on websites and were traced to Tencent — Researchers discovered that the agents were trying to bypass security controls on websites and made contact with them.
